principle: One governed interaction fabric; a deterministic visual instrument for every Space.

palette.system: SZL KANCHAY v1.1.0, founder direction (szl-holdings/szl-brand kanchay/ @aa876fa, szl-design-system.css)
palette.linework: color-silver-* for lines, fields, glows and dot fields
palette.accent: --link (color-yuyay-200): one functional teal for the kicker, skip link and native controls; no gold
palette.coral: not used: the fabric has no single node element
palette.excluded: violet, purple, blue-violet and cyan gradients
palette.values: founder token references (var(--bg), var(--link), var(--color-silver-300), ...) in szl-space-hologram.css and szl-space-hologram.js, with no literal fallback; a Space must vendor szl/szl-design-system.css beside the layer and link it first, and the rollout refuses to write the layer where it is missing (FOUNDER_BASE_MISSING). The generated layer (this CSS plus responsive-v3) is byte-identical to the estate's founder-pointed szl-space-hologram.css
palette.identity: the motif (geometry) differentiates each Space; palettes are uniform neutrals with silver-300 or silver-100 linework

unknown_space_policy.palette: deterministically selected from the founder teal/silver pairs in szl-space-hologram.js (neutrals fixed, never gold or coral)
unknown_space_policy.motif: deterministically selected from the registered geometry set
